panels.scene: WALT sits on the porch with a chess set, working out a move, his iPhone resting screen-down beside the board in soft morning light.
panels.caption: He gets asked first.

panels.scene: Close on WALT's iPhone on the porch table beside the chess set, the screen lit plainly, no app visible, nothing else on the table but the chess pieces.
panels.caption: One quiet question, just for him.

panels.scene: WALT glances at his phone at the porch table, thick-framed glasses on, calm, then goes back to studying the chess board.
panels.caption: The family hears from us only if he doesn't answer.
